features.description: Expose typed spawn through stdlib and VM
acceptance_criteria: Register Process.spawnProcessResult and _process_spawn_result with Result[ProcessHandle, ProcessError] metadata and wrapper.
NotFound, NotAllowed including narrowed subcommands and confinement, OS SpawnFailed, and BeginWorker/Complete failures return typed Err after capability checking.
